heros.infro: Rurik, whose name means "famous ruler," was a varangian chieftain who gained control of Ladoga in 862 and built the Holmgard settlement near Novgorod. He is the founder of Rurik Dyanasty which ruled Kievian Rus and then Galicia-Vohynia until 14th and Muscovy until 16th century.
heros.name: Rurik
